title: Nonlinear Stability of Taylor-Couette Flows with Heat Buoyancy
summary: This paper investigates the nonlinear stability of Taylor-Couette (TC) flows incorporating the thermal buoyancy within an annular domain characterized by small viscosity $ν$ and thermal diffusivity $μ$. It is well established that the buoyancy induced convection significantly impacts practical industrial applications of Taylor-Couette flow \cite{Chen2006}. In contrast to \cite{An.2024}, we specifically examines the influence of the temperature gradients and the gravity on the stability of Taylor-Couette flows in this article.
